seoTitle: Albuquerque Public Schools Calendar 2026–27 | Key Dates
seoDescription: See Albuquerque Public Schools' 2026–27 first days, holidays, breaks, virtual learning days, grading dates, official PDF, and calendar download.
heroSummary: For 2026–27, APS students in grades 1–12 start Friday, August 7, while Pre-K and kindergarten students start Tuesday, August 11. Fall Break is Friday, October 9. Winter Break runs December 21 through January 1, and Spring Break runs March 22–25, followed by the Vernal Holiday on March 26. The last day for students is Thursday, May 27, 2027.
calendarNotes: Most APS schools, including traditional and Transformational Opportunity Pilot Schools, follow the main district calendar. Grades 1–12 start August 7; Pre-K and kindergarten start August 11. The November 23–24 and March 29–30 parent-teacher conference dates use virtual sync/asynchronous learning. APS publishes quarter dates for K–8, middle, and high schools and trimester dates for K–5 elementary schools. College & Career High School follows a separate CNM-aligned calendar. APS also publishes the printable calendar in English and seven translated editions.

sourceReviewSummary: Main district dates were checked against the APS School Calendars and Grading Periods page and English printable calendar on August 11, 2026. College & Career High School dates were checked against APS's separate 2026–27 CCHS calendar.
sourceReviewDetails: We verified grade-specific first days, school closures, breaks, virtual learning/conference days, grading-term endings, graduation week, and the last day for students against the official APS calendar page, and cross-checked the English printable PDF where those dates are listed.

The APS webpage names Labor Day, Indigenous Peoples' Day, Election Day, Veterans Day, Martin Luther King Jr. Day, Presidents Day, and the Vernal Holiday, while the compact PDF sometimes uses the generic label Holiday. The event list uses the more specific official webpage labels.
The conference dates are represented as virtual learning dates, not school closures, because APS describes them as virtual sync/asynchronous learning days.

College & Career High School follows the CNM academic calendar with differences; school-specific bell schedules, testing, transportation, athletics, performances, and graduation ceremony details are outside this districtwide list.
APS lists English plus seven translated printable calendars. Each translated link below points to the official APS file supplied for that language.

calendarFaqs.q: When does Albuquerque Public Schools start in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: APS students in grades 1-12 start Friday, August 7, 2026. Pre-K and kindergarten students start Tuesday, August 11, 2026.

calendarFaqs.q: When is APS Fall Break in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Albuquerque Public Schools has a one-day Fall Break on Friday, October 9, 2026. Schools are also closed Monday, October 12 for Indigenous Peoples' Day.

calendarFaqs.q: When is APS Winter Break in 2026-27?
calendarFaqs.a: APS Winter Break runs Monday, December 21, 2026, through Friday, January 1, 2027. January 4 is a staff professional development day with no school for students; students return January 5.

calendarFaqs.q: When is APS Spring Break in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: APS Spring Break runs Monday, March 22, through Thursday, March 25, 2027. Schools are also closed Friday, March 26 for the Vernal Holiday.

calendarFaqs.q: Are the APS parent-teacher conference dates school holidays?
calendarFaqs.a: No. APS identifies November 23-24 and March 29-30 as K-12 parent-teacher conference and virtual sync/asynchronous learning days. Students may have remote work rather than a regular campus day.

calendarFaqs.q: Does College & Career High School follow this APS calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: Not exactly. APS says College & Career High School follows the CNM academic calendar with some differences. Students should use that school's calendar and announcements.

calendarFaqs.q: Is the Albuquerque APS calendar available in other languages?
calendarFaqs.a: Yes. APS publishes 2026-27 printable calendars in English, Spanish, Arabic, Simplified Chinese, Dari, Farsi, Swahili, and Vietnamese.

calendarFaqs.q: Does the downloaded APS calendar update automatically?
calendarFaqs.a: No. The file is a one-time import and will not automatically reflect later APS revisions, weather closures, or school-specific events.
